name: How do I choose a commercial damage restoration company?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a commercial damage restoration company?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a commercial damage restoration company, look for experience, proper licensing and certifications (like IICRC), and a proven track record with commercial properties. Consider their response time, availability for emergency services, and whether they offer comprehensive services from mitigation to reconstruction. Check customer reviews and ask for references. A company that communicates clearly and works with insurance providers can also simplify the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a company with experience, proper licensing, quick response times, comprehensive services, and good reviews for commercial damage restoration.
